Gilbert pickups, from the Heritage District to San Tan Village

Scottsdale Sprinters is a Scottsdale chauffeured transportation company serving metro Phoenix. Gilbert books the largest groups of any city on this list. The Heritage District in Downtown Gilbert is a dining destination in its own right, and the neighbourhoods around it — Agritopia, Morrison Ranch, Seville, Val Vista, Lyons Gate — generate wedding parties, family celebrations and shuttle runs that need real seat count.

How we work in Gilbert

A Gilbert wedding usually needs two things at once: guests moved from a hotel block and a wedding party moved separately, both on a schedule nobody wants to manage on the day. One large chauffeured vehicle running a repeating loop for a fixed number of hours does that, and it is billed the same way whether it is moving or waiting.

Where we pick up in Gilbert

We pick up across West Gilbert and the Heritage District, North Gilbert near Val Vista and San Tan Village, and South and Southeast Gilbert through Seville, Power Ranch, Agritopia, Higley, Morrison Ranch and Lyons Gate out to the Queen Creek border.

Frequently asked questions

Can you run a wedding shuttle loop in Gilbert?

Yes. A large vehicle running a repeating hotel-to-venue loop for a set number of hours is the standard arrangement, and it is billed at the same hourly rate whether it is driving or waiting at the kerb.

How big a group can you seat?

Up to 56 passengers in a single vehicle, with several sizes below that. Two vehicles cover anything larger. Luggage and gear fit is confirmed separately, in writing, before payment.

Do you serve the Heritage District and Agritopia?

Yes — Downtown Gilbert and the Heritage District, Agritopia and Higley, Morrison Ranch, Seville and Power Ranch, Val Vista and San Tan Village are all inside the normal Gilbert service area.

When should a Gilbert wedding party book?

Availability varies by date and by vehicle. Request a current quote for your date and we confirm in writing what is open. Large groups and multi-vehicle bookings also get the longer cancellation window: a full refund 30 or more days out.
